title: ProblemRecord
description: The problem as given, recorded as stated and not as true. Single writer: Controller (Intake). Append-only; a correction is a new record referencing this one.

id.description: Record id: a lower-case type prefix, a hyphen, at least three digits. Unique within a run.

ledger_version.description: The ledger version this record was written against. A CandidateRecord citing a version other than the frozen one is rejected by the Scribe.

references.description: Ids of the records this one is derived from or responds to. Never edit those records; reference them.

statement.description: The problem statement verbatim or lightly trimmed.

context.description: Context the requester supplied. Empty string if none.

constraints.description: Constraints as stated by the requester. Classifying them is the Framer's job.

acceptance_criteria.description: Criteria the requester supplied. May be empty; the Framer then proposes them in the FrameRecord.
